en: Black‑and‑white image showing a formal cavalry review on open grassland. In the foreground at left, an officer in ornate uniform with a tall fur cap sits on a light‑colored horse, holding a baton or staff. Behind him stretches a long formation of mounted lancers in uniform, each holding a long lance with a pennant attached, forming parallel rows that recede into the distance. Another officer on horseback faces the line at the far right. The sky is blank and overexposed; there is no visible writing or border decoration.
